findings.passage: Under the Constitution, we can only restrict weapons in spaces similar to those that saw firearm restriction under longstanding legal precedent. I am convinced that restrictions so broad as to incorporate office buildings and wilderness preserves violate the Constitution. Regents do not have discretion to violate it.
findings.note: Quoted by Complete Colorado (reporter Sherrie Peif) while speaking against a proposed University of Colorado regents policy banning concealed carry across all university property. He says broad bans covering office buildings and wilderness research sites exceed what the Constitution allows.

findings.passage: It is inappropriate for us to tempt lawsuits at the fringe of Constitution permissibility over symbolic actions,
findings.note: Quoted by Complete Colorado on the same proposed campus concealed-carry ban. He calls the ban a symbolic action that risks lawsuits; he also said it would be unenforceable and costly to enforce.
